response.assayComponentEndpointDesc: Data from the assay component ERF_TW_ENZ_ATPase_NK was analyzed at the assay endpoint, ERF_TW_ENZ_ATPase_NK, bidirectionally relative to DMSO as the negative control and baseline of activity. Using a type of enzyme reporter, loss-of-signal activity can be used to understand changes in binding as they relate to gene ATP1A1. To generalize the intended target to other relatable targets, this assay endpoint is annotated to the transporter intended target family, where the subfamily is atpase.
response.assayComponentDesc: ERF_TW_ENZ_ATPase_NK is an assay component calculated from the ERF_TW_ENZ_ATPase_NK assay. It is designed to measure enzyme activity using a type of enzyme reporter as detected by colorimetric with spectrophotometry technology.
response.assayComponentTargetDesc: Changes in absorbance produced from the enzyme activity involving the key ligand, ATP + biomol green reagent, are indicative of changes in regulation of catalytic activity related to the gene ATP1A1.
response.assayDesc: ERF_TW_ENZ_ATPase_NK is a biochemical, single-readout assay that uses extracted gene-proteins from pig heart in a tissue-based cell-free assay. Measurements were taken 1 hour after chemical dosing in a 96-well plate. See ATPase (Na+/K+) Pig Heart Enzymatic LeadHunter Assay â€“ TW.
